turns.content: For a spin-1/2 muon, the component operators are P_x=(hbar/2)[[0,1],[1,0]], P_y=(hbar/2)[[0,-i],[i,0]], and P_z=(hbar/2)[[1,0],[0,-1]]. Identify the corresponding Pauli matrices and write the operator vector compactly.
For the unit direction n=(sin(theta),0,cos(theta)) in the x-z plane, form the dimensionless projected matrix M=2(P dot n)/hbar and write its two-by-two entries.
Solve the positive-eigenvalue equation for M and derive the component ratio of a normalized eigenvector of P dot n with eigenvalue +hbar/2, up to an overall phase.
Apply M directly to the proposed spinor and check its norm. How does this verification show why the angular dependence uses theta/2 rather than theta?
State the normalized spin-up eigenvector along n, including the freedom to multiply it by an overall phase.
